# Reusable Skills

- project-architecture — map and evolve the existing app safely.
- frontend-design — storefront UX, responsive design and accessibility.
- ecommerce-development — catalog/cart/checkout implementation and regression coverage.
- supabase-readonly-audit — database/RPC/RLS inspection without writes.
- quality-assurance — tests, build and acceptance evidence.
- security-audit — frontend/dependency/privacy review.
- seo-conversion — search visibility and ethical conversion improvement.
- cloudflare-operations — CI and preview readiness; no production changes.

Each Skill is project-specific and must be reviewed before reuse in another app.
